canonical_project: Haidong green computing cluster including China Mobile, China Telecom, Kingsoft Cloud, Cambricon, Shenzhen Yuyang and Xiaomi projects
notes: Haidong Industrial Park states Haidong has 14 completed green-computing projects with RMB7.394bn invested, six under construction, six newly signed, and built China Mobile and China Telecom big-data centers plus Kingsoft Cloud, Cambricon, Shenzhen Yuyang and Xiaomi intelligent-computing application projects.
